snippet.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World | Move strategically or perish
snippet.description:
🛒 Steam Store:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842320/Slayer__the_Demon_Haunted_World/

Move strategically or perish.
A Souls-like action RPG reimagined with unique grid-based combat.
Face terrifying monsters, survive deadly traps, and uncover the truth in a world haunted by evil.
